['Select molecule_chembl_id as chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units', 'From activities', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', 'Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', "Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054501'", 'Filter activities.standard_value is not null', "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='", 'Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units', 'No limit']
